children: Marsh, who joined the company in July 2021, sold the shares at an average price of 146.26p each, for a total value of £731,337.50.
Following the sale, Marsh holds a beneficial interest in 1.68m ordinary Currys shares.
As of 1530 BST, Currys shares were up 0.13% at 151.10p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
